pipewire_server.description: The name of the PipeWire server daemon to connect to.

pipewire_node.description: The node ID to use, -1 means auto-select.

pipewire_exclusive.description: Whether to open the stream in exclusive mode.

pipewire_role.description: The role of the stream (e.g., Audio/Production, Audio/Multimedia).

pipewire_format.description: The sample format, empty string means auto-detect.

pipewire_channels.description: The number of channels, 0 means auto-detect.

pipewire_period_bytes.description: The period size in bytes, 0 means auto-detect.

pipewire_buffer_bytes.description: The buffer size in bytes, 0 means auto-detect.
